marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 knots increasing to northwest 30 Thursday
morning then diminishing to west 20 Thursday evening. Periods of snow. Visibility 1 mile or less in
snow. Temperatures near minus 3. Freezing spray beginning Thursday morning and ending Thursday
evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text: Seas 1 metre building to 2 early Thursday morning.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Friday: Wind west 20 knots.<br/>Saturday: Wind west 15 knots diminishing to light late
